data.body: Ticket 5's change 2453 got LLM-Review-1 with 1 blocking + 2 advisory findings, all legitimate: missing regression test for advisory's None threshold, a real TypeError crash risk on non-numeric priority (>= comparison unguarded), and a missing exact-boundary test. Per the skill's "behavioral gate finding gets a RED test first" rule: added 4 tests (advisory-passes-maximal-priority, boundary-exact-threshold-fails, non-numeric-priority-no-crash [confirmed RED with TypeError first]), fixed _fails to use isinstance(priority, (int,float)) instead of bare priority is not None. All 18 tests green, lint/format/mypy clean, amended commit 91a4661, re-pushed patchset 2 to https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2453.
